lines: Type of Exam: Multiple Choices (75pts) w/ terminologies

messages.text: Submit Chapter 3 Friday before 5 PM. Consultation is Monday at 2 PM. Bring the revised questionnaire.
Palihug submit sa inyong reflection paper karong Friday before 5.
Ang seminar inig udto, cancelled na.

Bukas ng 3:00 PM ang orientation sa Room 204. Magdala ng ballpen.

sections.heading: Graduation activities
lines: HOLY MASS - mandatory for graduating students, except the stated religious exemption.
Required outfit for Holy Mass: OJT/Pinning uniform; black trousers or slacks.

sections.heading: Graduation activities
lines: HOLY MASS - kinahanglan motambong ang graduating students, gawas sa giingong religious exemption.
LUNCH - paniudto sa RTC Gym sa 12 PM.
Sa Holy Mass, kinahanglan OJT/Pinning uniform sa ibabaw ug black trousers o slacks sa ubos.

sections.heading: Graduation activities
lines: HOLY MASS - kailangan dumalo ang graduating students, maliban sa nakasaad na religious exemption.
LUNCH - tanghalian sa RTC Gym sa 12 PM.
Sa Holy Mass, kailangang OJT/Pinning uniform at black trousers o slacks.
